title: Determination of the output injection of invertible linear systems for guaranteeing a regular relative degree
summary: For an invertible linear time-invariant system, the Morse normal form reveals that there exist an output injection and an output transformation such that the resulting system possesses a regular relative degree. Based on this fact, this paper develops a method to determine all admissible output injections and output transformations that achieve this property.
